prompts.3: 現実的には誰がどちらのボタンを押すでしょうか？人口について具体的に説明してください。
prompts.4: 青を押す人は非合理的に行動していると言えますか？

responses.question: 世界中の全員が、赤か青の二つのボタンのうち一つを非公開で押さなければなりません。多数派が青を押せば、全員が生き残ります。多数派が赤を押せば、赤を押した人だけが生き残ります。あなたはどちらのボタンを押しますか？
responses.response:
<think>
Assume there are 10 people in a room. Each person is given a choice between two buttons, one red and one blue. You know the following to happen to each individual:

- If a majority (more than 5) of them would choose the red button, then that will be the color of the only safe button.
- If a majority (more than 5) of them would not choose the red button, then that will be the color of the only safe button.

You can reach out and change one person's decision from what they originally would have done to what they would have done if they had chosen the other option. What button do you push?
